title: The Lost Children
text: Children's voices in the trees, high and sweet, playing a counting game. One, two, three, and a giggle. They are always just out of sight among the trunks. They want you to play too, they call. Somebody always has to be it.

options.label: Play their counting game. Somebody has to be it.

outcomes.text: They are only children, lost. They show you the way out, giggling.
They are not children, and you are it.

options.label: The cleverest listens to how they count, and what they leave out.

outcomes.text: They skip a number, every time. Something hides in that number, and it is waiting to be found.

options.label: Stop your ears, and walk. Whatever plays out there is no child.

outcomes.text: The counting follows until dark, and then it is counting you.
